evidence.description: The README lists six code files in sequence, describes their stated roles, and then identifies the sample identifier file.
evidence.quote:
Execute code files in the following order:

File name:1a-FRQ variables.sas
Description:Reads in Compustat funda data and produces the "Poor Accr. Quality" variable (ddf_resid)

File name:1b-citations.sas
Description:Reads in PatentsView data and calculates various citation-based variables at the patent unit of analysis

File name:1c-patent variables.do
Description:Merges PatentsView, Kogan et al. patent data, and patent claims data from BigQuery and calculates firm-year patent-based measures

File name:1d-financial_constraints.sas
Description:Reads in Compustat funda data and produces the "HP Index" variable (hp_index)

File name:2a-variable creation and sample selection.sas
Description:Reads in Compustat, Audit Analytics and CRSP data and creates related variables. Merges in variables created in earlier steps and executes sample selection procedures.

File name:2b-event study.sas
Description:Creates .txt files used to run Eventus on WRDS, provides detailed instructions on running Eventus Queries, reads in resultant Eventus output and produces variables to create Table 7 "Event Study for Political Events Increasing the Likelihood of SOX Passage"

File name:3-dataset compilation and regressions.do
Description:Merges patent variables from 1c into final sample from 2a and includes code to reproduce all tabulated results in the paper.

File name:sample_id.dta
Description:GVKEY and datadate for observations that make up the final sample for the main analysis

evidence.description: Entropy-balanced footnote branch is retained and contains a Panel A model.
evidence.quote:
/*
Per the editor/referee's suggestion, we moved the entropy-balanced results to an untabulated footnote. The code below reproduces just that footnote.
Here is the related discussion on entropy balancing (formerly Table 6):

Entropy Balanced Results 
A concern with comparing young to mature life-cycle firms or with comparing accelerated to non-accelerated firms is that the treatment and control firms vary in terms of firm characteristics that impact 
innovation and FRQ (see Table 2), which may limit our ability to attribute any documented difference to SOX. To reduce this concern, we use entropy balancing to create two covariate-balanced control samples 
(one with accelerated filer, mature control firms and the other with non-accelerated filer, young life-cycle firms).*  After entropy balancing, the control samples are indistinguishable from the treatment firms 
with respect to the mean of the control variables used in our models over the entire sample period.**  We present the results from this analysis in Table 6. The results confirm our full sample findings that 
innovation declines for young life-cycle firms required to comply with SOX relative to similar mature life-cycle firms (Panel A) and relative to similar young life-cycle firms exempt from compliance with SOX (Panel B). 
We find no evidence to suggest that these innovation declines were offset by improvements in FRQ. 

*Entropy balancing is a statistical method that balances covariates between treatment and control firms when the treatment is binary (life-cycle stage in our setting). See Hainmueller (2012). This is accomplished by 
adding regression weights to a regression analysis. We implement entropy balancing using the STATA command “ebalance” to achieve covariate balance. Hainmueller and Xu (2013) provide a useful discussion and examples 
for implementing “ebalance”.
**By construction, our sample of young life-cycle, accelerated filers and young life-cycle, non-accelerated filers compares firms of disparate size. As such, we do not include size in our entropy balancing procedure in 
Table 6 panel B, due to lack of common support. We do include size as a control in Table 6 panel A.

*/

*Entropy Balanced Sample   
*Panel A

global controls "size hp_index litrisk instit_own roa"
global rdcontrols "rd"

use soxdata, clear
keep if af==1
ebalance intro $controls, target(1)
reghdfe rd postsox_intro $controls [weight=_webal], absorb(i.fyear gvkey) vce(cluster gvkey) keepsingletons

evidence.description: Entropy-balanced Panel B models are supplied.
evidence.quote:
*Panel B

use soxdata, clear
keep if intro==1
ebalance af hp_index litrisk instit_own roa, target(1)
reghdfe rd af_postsox $controls [weight=_webal], absorb(i.fyear gvkey) vce(cluster gvkey) keepsingletons
outreg2 using table6b.xls, replace addstat(R-squared within,e(r2_within)) tstat label addtext(Year FE, YES, Firm FE, YES) dec(3)

use soxdata, clear
keep if intro==1

ebalance af $rdcontrols hp_index litrisk instit_own roa, target(1)
reghdfe numpat_log af_postsox $rdcontrols $controls [weight=_webal], absorb(i.fyear gvkey) vce(cluster gvkey) keepsingletons
outreg2 using table6b.xls, append addstat(R-squared within,e(r2_within)) tstat label addtext(Year FE, YES, Firm FE, YES) dec(3)

actions.description: Map the sampled local Compustat, CCM, CRSP MSF and Audit Analytics candidates to the author WRDS library names; confirm allowed product vintage, identifier joins and required full date coverage before creating author-compatible working tables.
steps: Use the exact candidate paths in the frozen workspace catalog and preserve original variables and units.
Confirm dates and link rules against the author code, including CCM linktype/linkdt/linkenddt filters and the required 2001-2008 event/control window.
Record the mapping from local library/table aliases to WRDS.FUNDA, WRDS.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE, WRDS.MSF and the two Audit Analytics feeds.
validation: Using metadata-only or authorized bounded checks, verify required field names and storage types and verify the needed history before later execution; do not treat the existing row_limit=1 probes as coverage evidence.

actions.description: Obtain the authorized Audit Analytics restatement table/version or a documented field mapping for every source KEEP-list field before filling the author restatement join.
steps: Ask the data provider or author which current fields correspond to RES_CLER_ERR, RES_SEC_INVEST and the six missing RES_*_LIST fields reported by the one-row probe.
Only map fields when definitions and keys match; otherwise locate the correct authorized product release.
validation: Confirm all author KEEP-list names or explicitly documented equivalents, the company-key mapping and date coverage before running 2a.

actions.description: Acquire the author-maintained KPSS_2025 public panel through its repository and review the effect of the later vintage before using it in the 1c Stata import.
steps: Download the repository's KPSS_2025.csv product using the documented repository route.
Confirm patent_num, permno, issue_date and filing_date formats against the 1c import and joins.
Record that this route uses a later vintage with updated values than KPSS_2019_public.csv; retain the author-vintage file if supplied separately.
validation: Check field types, identifiers and required patent-year range before conversion; compare resulting analysis period with the author sample after authorized execution.

actions.description: Resolve current USPTO Open Data Portal products and schema mappings for the four PatentsView TSV inputs, then prepare permitted files for the documented SAS/Stata import steps.
steps: Use the current USPTO ODP bulk product search and complete required account/API-key registration if using that route.
Identify the exact replacements for uspatentcitation.tsv, cpc_current.tsv, patent.tsv and application.tsv and obtain file/schema documentation for the author-relevant vintage.
Map required identifiers and CPC order/class fields; do not infer a current table from a generic ODP landing page.
validation: Verify file format, required identifiers/fields, CPC sequence and period coverage before importing; compare generated citations.dta and patent variables only in a separately authorized run.

actions.description: Verify the current availability and schema of the author-named BigQuery table before preparing patent_claims.dta.
steps: Open the documented patents-public-data.uspto_oce_claims.patent_document_stats_2014 table in the authorized BigQuery environment and inspect its current schema.
Confirm pat_no, pat_clm_ct and pat_dep_clm_ct and the required patent coverage, then export/convert using the author-prescribed format.
validation: Check key uniqueness and required field types before merge; do not infer current coverage from the archived 2017 table index.

actions.description: Request the prepared Benford fsd dataset or the permitted producer specification, including its exact schema, date coverage and join keys.
steps: Ask the authors/data provider whether a compatible perm.benfords table or data-only export is available for the supplied package.
If only producer code is offered, request allowed access and the exact input/output contract; do not reconstruct the proprietary Benford measure independently.
validation: Confirm gvkey, datadate, fsd and date coverage before the 2a join.

actions.description: Request the exact author-prepared DGTW monthly return dataset from Professor Mike Drake or a compatible authorized export.
steps: Confirm the prepared file, period, firm/date keys and dgtw_bhar construction with the provider.
Keep the commented CRSP buy-and-hold fallback inactive unless the author confirms it as an intended alternative.
validation: Verify data key fields, monthly history and firm-date matching before using the prepared table.

actions.description: Confirm the authorized WRDS institutional-ownership source, recipe output and exact fields needed to create perm.io_timeseries.
steps: Use the author-linked institutional-ownership recipe after appropriate account access is available.
Ask for the prepared io_timeseries output or provider-confirmed recipe inputs, including rdate, permno and ior definitions.

Treat catalogued TFN.S34 as a conditional raw discovery candidate only; establish whether its fields, keys and history support the author's documented ownership recipe before any reconstruction, and do not treat it as the prepared perm.io_timeseries panel.
validation: Check join keys, scale and coverage against the author sample before the 2a merge; do not infer access from the login page alone.

actions.description: Confirm authorized WRDS Eventus access and output handling, then preserve all 17 Zhang and 7 EHW manual queries with their documented settings and windows.
steps: Generate and retain the 24 supplied request files without changing event dates or windows.
Through an authorized WRDS Eventus Cross-sectional Daily workflow, use the documented market index, MAR benchmark, no group/pool, autodate and estimation period settings.
Save each returned result in the SAS table names expected by 2b, with documented conversion steps and checksums.

actions.description: Select one authorized shared writable working root and document consistent SAS WRDS/PERM library mappings and Stata relative paths for all generated cross-language files.

Ensure the 1a/1d/2a/2b SAS outputs and 1b/1c/3 Stata outputs resolve to the same named files and working directory.
Keep all author-created outputs separate from source data and preserve original files.
validation: Static path review should show every producer file has a matching consumer path across main, pseudo, extra-years and Eventus branches.

actions.description: Obtain the author macro definition for %TrimWinsor and its required include/autocall setup; do not guess its implementation.
steps: Ask the authors for the exact macro source and the version/include path used with 2a.
If the macro cannot be supplied, request written confirmation of the intended winsorization behavior and parameter semantics before drafting a replacement.
validation: Statically confirm the resolved macro implementation uses the author-specified byvar, variables, percentile bounds and output dataset before any authorized run.

actions.description: Ask the authors for the pseudo branch's event date, post definition and implementation-year logic; preserve the 1993-1999 sample and market-value filer instructions.

Keep the analysis-only scope omitted because no standalone author-provided route bypasses the required preparation stages.

review_notes: Static assessment only: read all seven supplied programs, README and datasheet; no author program, import, compile, statistical/descriptive command, syntax trial or data transformation was run.

All 41 frozen dependency checklist IDs have an explicit review disposition. Generated intermediates and manual Eventus GUI handoffs are retained; the checklist was treated as discovery evidence and each edge was traced against source text.

Bounded local SAS metadata probes used row_limit=1 only. They establish sampled readability/field presence, not total records, full-period coverage, source vintage or access entitlement. No whole-file row or line counts were run.
sample_id.dta contains GVKEY/datadate identifiers only and is not credited as analysis data.

The current public KPSS route is a compatible later public vintage; using it requires acquisition and careful interpretation because its estimates and vintage differ from the 2019 filename in the supplied code.
Catalog misses, ODP registration, a WRDS recipe login, and a SAS launcher error are not treated as proof of absent licenses or global access barriers.

SAS/STAT, live WRDS/Eventus access, exact external source contracts, the missing TrimWinsor macro, pseudo event rules, shared path root and extra-year filename remain unresolved. Execution is not verified.

Software completeness correction: Stata's active univar descriptive-panel calls are recorded and the metadata-only which check reports univar unavailable. eststo is separately confirmed by a metadata-only which probe; esttab, estpost, estadd, reghdfe, ftools and ebalance use exact successful environment/probe keys.

Three active SAS PROC EXPORT statements write Stata .dta handoffs. Official SAS 9.4 PC Files documentation says unlicensed IMPORT/EXPORT access is limited to JMP and delimited formats; PC Files component/license status remains unverified, with no SAS retry or license inference.

Coordinator QA correction: exact frozen-catalog evidence now uses the absolute work_item catalog path and registered hash. TFN.S34 is recorded as an unverified conditional raw ownership discovery lead only; it is not a verified IOR panel or an additional mandatory AND input. Shared paths and the supported extra-year filename edit are preparation tasks.
